last.verdict: Cloudflare's growth sped up to 39%, its fastest in nearly four years, and it raised its year-end forecast by about $100 million.

takeaways.label: Growth accelerating
takeaways.text: Revenue rose 39% to $782.5M, up from 36% last quarter and above the roughly $737M analysts expected. Annualized revenue passed $3 billion.

takeaways.label: Big guidance raise
takeaways.text: Full-year revenue is now guided to about $2.963–2.964B, up from $2.864–2.870B. Q4 is guided to $845–846M, well above the roughly $796M analysts expected.

takeaways.label: Profit up, margins mixed
takeaways.text: Adjusted operating margin rose to 17.5% from 15.3%. Gross margin slipped to 72.4% from 75.3% a year ago, and GAAP net loss widened to $34.1M.

takeaways.label: Cash flow lags
takeaways.text: Free cash flow was $82.1M, 10% of revenue, down from 13% a year ago, as spending on equipment rose to $121.8M from $84.6M.

history.verdict: Accelerating growth and a raised full-year outlook won buyers, though much of the after-hours pop faded.

reasons.label: Growth sped up
reasons.text: Revenue rose 36% from a year earlier, up from 34% last quarter, beating expectations.

reasons.label: Margins and one-time costs
reasons.text: Gross margin fell to 73.1% from 76.3%; a $150.7M restructuring charge weighed on results.
